summary: The proposal outlines an interesting self‑service platform but suffers from several critical structural and compliance issues. Missing required sections, exceeding length limits, and incomplete AI transparency significantly hinder its readiness, while additional major and minor concerns require attention.

findings.title: Missing Abstract Section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Abstract section, which is a required part of the structure.

findings.title: Proposal Exceeds Maximum Length
findings.description: The proposal spans 10 pages of text, exceeding the allowed maximum of 6 pages for a complete proposal.

findings.title: Solution described in Problem section
findings.description: The Problem section presents a concrete solution (a self‑service platform with expiry) which violates the guideline that the Problem section must only describe problems and their negative consequences.

locations.quote: A **self-service platform** that arms the workflow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time **would end this accumulation**.

findings.title: Missing AI tool usage review confirmation
findings.description: The AI Transparency Statement does not contain a sentence confirming that the author has carefully checked all AI‑generated text, as required by the guidelines.

locations.quote: I used **the following generative artificial intelligence (AI) tool while preparing this proposal**.

findings.title: Double verbs in Objective formulation
findings.description: Objective "Design and implement connectors with expiry" uses two verbs, violating the rule that each objective should be formulated with a single action verb.

findings.title: Figure caption too short
findings.description: The caption for Figure 2 is generic and not sufficiently descriptive, violating the requirement for long, informative captions.

findings.title: Missing introductory text before first subsection
findings.description: Section "Introduction" jumps directly to subsection 1.1 without any introductory paragraph, violating the guideline that every section must include introductory text before its first subsection.

findings.title: Inconsistent spelling and terminology
findings.description: The terms “Recertifcation”/“recertifcation” and “workfow” are spelled inconsistently, which may cause confusion.

locations.quote: I will attach a **recertifcation** interval to each resource
the **workfow** engine of Keycloak at grant time

locations.section: 4.3 Delegate Request Review Without Privilege Escalation

findings.title: Informal language usage
findings.description: Contractions and superlatives are used (e.g., "doesn’t" and "worst"), which are discouraged in formal academic writing.

locations.quote: The current process **doesn’t** scale and is the worst bottleneck of the chair.
